design_philosophy: A high-intensity, data-driven betting intelligence command center. Blends DraftKings' gamified player-pick cards with Bloomberg Terminal's data density. Uses tactical minimalism: 1px borders, high contrast pure white text on deep obsidian, and electric accent colors for lock scores.

bottom_nav.style: fixed bottom-0 left-0 w-full h-20 border-t border-white/10 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-xl flex justify-around items-center z-50 pb-safe

filter_chips.chip_base: px-4 py-2 rounded-full border text-sm font-semibold whitespace-nowrap transition-all

lock_pick_card.style: relative w-full rounded-2xl border border-white/10 bg-gradient-to-b from-[#1A1A1A] to-[#0A0A0A] p-5 overflow-hidden
lock_pick_card.score_badge: absolute top-4 right-4 flex flex-col items-center justify-center w-14 h-14 rounded-full border-2 bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-md shadow-lg
lock_pick_card.progress_bar: h-2 w-full bg-zinc-800 rounded-full overflow-hidden mt-2

bet_killer_screen.warning_banner: bg-red-500/10 border-b border-red-500/30 p-4 flex items-center gap-3 text-red-500
bet_killer_screen.card_style: p-5 rounded-xl border border-red-500/30 bg-red-950/20 backdrop-blur-sm

icons.usage: Bold, consistent stroke width (2px). Use standard imports.

hero_background.description: Dark soccer stadium with night lights to be used as a subtle, low-opacity background behind the main dashboard or header.

ai_data_texture.description: Abstract orange network lines, to be used sparingly as an overlay with 'mix-blend-screen' and 10% opacity in the 'Why This Pick?' AI explanation sections.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a mobile-first web application using React (.js files), Tailwind CSS, and Shadcn UI.
Do NOT use pure black (#000000) for large background areas; stick to #0A0A0A and #141414.
Implement bottom tab navigation utilizing sticky/fixed positioning (z-50) so it overlays content correctly. Leave bottom padding (pb-24) on main content.
Design Lock Pick cards as the hero component. The Lock Score must be a prominent circular badge at the top right, utilizing the specific grade colors from the palette.
ALL interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='filter-chip-nba', data-testid='lock-pick-card-score', data-testid='bottom-nav-home').
In the Bet Killer screen, use an aggressive red/dark-red aesthetic to warn users away from bad bets. Incorporate visual tension.
Add font imports for 'Barlow Condensed' and 'IBM Plex Sans' from Google Fonts in the index.html or global CSS. Use Barlow for headings/numbers and IBM Plex for standard text.
For the 'Win Probability' and 'Edge %' metrics, use horizontal progress bars with vibrant accent colors matching their grade.
Ensure dark mode is forced/default on the application.
Use 1px borders (border-white/10) heavily for structure instead of relying on shadows, keeping the 'tactical' athletic aesthetic.
